mapper.select: select from student_point_account a where a.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into student_point_account (user_id, stage, total_points, available_points, level, streak_days, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{stage}, greatest(#{points}, 0), greatest(#{points}, 0), 1, 0, now(), now()) on duplicate key update total_points = total_points + greatest(#{points}, 0), available_points = available_points + #{points}, stage = values(stage), update_time = now()
mapper.update: update student_point_account set level = #{level}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and level <> #{level}
